definitions.full: H5506. sechorah [ סְחֹרָה ] noun feminine merchandise ; — construct סָחֹרַת Ezek 27:15 , but see סחר Participle סָפַק , [ שָׂפַק ], verb slap, clap (Late Hebrew Pi`el id. ; Arabic slap (face), strike (hands) Lane 1373 ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular וְסָפַק consecutive Jer 48:26 , suffix סְפָקָם Job 34:26 ; 1 singular סָפַ֫קְתִּי Jer 31:19 ; 3 plural סָֽפְקוּ Lam 2:15 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִשְׂמֹּק ( שׂ substantive for ס ) Job 27:23 , יִסְמּוֺק 34:37 , וַיִּסְמֹּק Num 24:10 ; Imperative masculine singular סְפֹק Ezek 21:17 ; — 1 slap , followed by עַליָֿרֵךְ on the thigh , in remorse and sorrow Jer 31:19 ; Ezek 21:17 ; with כַּמַּיִם clap one's hands Num 24:10 (in anger), with עַל at , Lam 2:15 ; Job 27:23 (in mockery); ׳כ omitted 34:37 (in presumptuousness, against God). 2 slap, chastise , with accusative of person Job 34:26 (subject God). 3 splash ׳וְס בְּקִיאוֺ מוֺאָב Jer 48:26 and Moab shall splash (fall with a splash) into his vomit , > Thes Buhl Lex 13 empty himself (?), throw up (compare Syriac Pa`el). Hiph`il Imperfect 3masculine plural יַשְׂמִּ֫יקוּ נָכְרִים וּבְיַלְרֵי Isa 2:6 (read perhaps וּבִידֵי Hi Du Che, and into the hands of foreigners they clap , literally cause to clap , that is, their hands; > ᵑ6 ᵐ5 from 1. שׂפק q. v., they abound in, have a sufficiency of).
